description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding for use as a summer house to the existing house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 2022-01-02 (Rev.A) and 2022-01-03 (Rev.A), received 14/01/2022, and Drawing 2022-01-01 (Rev.A) and Fire Safety Report, received 19/01/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used on the main house.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 15 Moulton Avenue, TW3 4LP, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
